Public AEXB camera fixtures

Fixed PUBLIC test keys, randomness and invented outpoints. No funds. Never use these keys for a wallet.

The failure creates valid ECDSA signatures using attacker-chosen small nonces instead of the committed host-tweaked nonces. It illustrates detection of nonce substitution, not the full Dark Skippy Schnorr seed-extraction attack. This is a test of these public examples, not proof that an implementation has no backdoors or that every malicious signer is detected. A malicious signer that incorporates rho can still pass these checks: never export real transcripts.

  1. In EntropyLab open Transactions → Nonce Inspector → Verify a live anti-exfil QR signing ceremony (prototype).
  2. Recommended: run EntropyLab on a camera-equipped tablet and show these fixtures on a separate computer. With a movable webcam, use separate monitors or two windows side by side on one screen. Aim at only this QR: several different payloads in one frame are refused. A fixed laptop camera needs another display/device or an external camera; a phone-as-webcam arrangement is another option.
  3. Click Allow Camera Access, approve the browser prompt, choose your camera, then click Scan Message 2.
  4. The camera pauses after every message. Click the Scan Message button again before each stage, and leave the QR animation visible while scanning. Any capture order works; this page shows 2, 3, 4 for clarity.
  5. Before switching scenarios, acknowledge a completed result. For an incomplete capture, click Clear Capture or End Session first.
  6. For success, expect the PASS dialog. In a real ceremony, scan M4 into EL first and continue with the same M4 in Sparrow only after EL passes. Both signatures are checked against the PSBT already carried in message 3. Captured messages are cleared automatically before this dialog appears. Click Clear Capture to acknowledge the result and continue.
  7. For failure, expect a STOP! Do not broadcast! dialog after stage 4. Captured messages are cleared automatically before this dialog appears. Stop the failed exchange; click Clear Capture to acknowledge the warning. Acknowledging does not make the failed exchange safe.

Reference signed PSBT (public test data; not needed for the camera test)

This public fixture is provided for independent test/review tools. The camera flow validates the embedded PSBT automatically and does not require copying this text. No real capture data is used or saved here.
